parent_objective: check whether the M641 source-balanced sequence target corpus has usable exact objective geometry before any actor update

public_gates: load the M641 NPZ and metadata without mutation
compute target versus base sequence distances
report train and source-heldout validation splits separately
confirm no actor parameters change and no training starts
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use source or target metadata as actor observations
do not report aggregate loss without source-balanced and split-specific breakdowns
hypothesis: The M641 source-balanced sequence corpus is exact-objective usable: target sequences differ meaningfully from base sequences while loss mass remains source-balanced and auditable by split.
success_criteria: weighted source contributions are finite and balanced
target/base sequence deltas are nonzero and bounded by recorded masks
train and source-heldout validation summaries are written separately
failure_criteria: metadata and NPZ row counts mismatch
target/base sequence deltas are all zero or non-finite
any optimizer or actor update is started
decision_rule: M642 passes as a proof gate if it writes finite source-balanced and split-specific exact objective summaries without starting training or changing the actor.
